name: Prasanna Kumar Swain / ପ୍ରସନ୍ନ କୁମାର ସ୍ଵାଇଁ

sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: Prasanna Kumar Swain is an Odia poet associated with Cuttack. Srujan’s first issue in 2021 published his poems “ବିପ୍ଳବ” and “କୋଟିଆ”; its contributor note places him in Jobra, Cuttack, and records teaching at the Sri Aurobindo centre at Matrubhaban. This literary background complements the brief introduction supplied to Kabita Live.

“ପ୍ରଶ୍ନଘେରରେ ପ୍ରସନ୍ନ” is built from questions that refuse easy answers. The speaker considers parental sacrifice, hunger, desire, literary recognition and the mysteries of nature. References to published books and applause give way to doubt about poetry itself. By bringing his own name into the title and ending, the poet makes that questioning personal without bringing it to a neat conclusion.
